name: Reply suggestions
author: Messages AI
description: Shows three suggested replies in bubbles above an open chat. Tap a bubble to send that reply, tap ↻ for three new ones, × hides them until you open another chat. New suggestions appear by themselves when a message arrives. In the Google Play version a tapped reply is typed into the text field and you send it. Uses your AI provider. Requires Messages AI 0.43.0 or newer.
